title: fix(app-shell): a member's record page asks no object definition the metadata door answers as absent
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D75mRNRrsy6GfiJD9q7La4j)_
Part of #33343 (item 2 only; item 1, the health `version`, is Area A4's own PR)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：成员打开记录页时，控制台不再按名读取两个它读不到的对象定义：`sys_business_unit`（来自每个对象都带的隐藏系统字段 `owning_business_unit_id`）和 `sys_comment_reaction`（评论表情的存储探测）。服务端一行未改。
- 为什么改：元数据门只把对象定义给读检查放行的调用者，对成员这两个对象都按"不存在"答 404；这个答案是对的（成员默认权限集没有这两个对象的读，也没有 `schemaReadDelegate`），错在页面去问，控制台于是每开一页就报两条 404。
- 风险与回滚：隐藏的查找字段不再预读目标定义，对所有人生效，但没有任何单元格画隐藏字段；表情探测只对"已加载权限且无读权"的调用者跳过，走的仍是原来 404 带去的那条路。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts` 的 `lookupTargetNames`（隐藏字段跳过）；`RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 `reactionReadRefused`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.feedGrant-12082.test.tsx`，预期全绿，其中 `objectstack#33343` 的两个 describe 共五例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A member opening a stock record page logged `404` on `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_business_unit` and `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_comment_reaction` (item `approvals.record-page-decisions`, sweep row 160).

**The rule these answers follow.** Under ADR-0106 as amended by ruling record 6787890900, the metadata door serves an object's definition only to a caller the object read check admits, and answers anyone else as if the object did not exist. Decision 6840464379 (the approval-request definitions) added one exception: an object whose owner declares `schemaReadDelegate` is served, field-projected, to the callers that owner's own door serves its rows to. Read at `origin/main` `ba35dfd7`: no shipped member set names `sys_business_unit` or `sys_comment_reaction` (`member_default` names neither; the showcase grants `sys_business_unit` read only to its field-ops delegate set), and neither object declares a delegate (only `sys_approval_request` and `sys_approval_action` do). Neither has an own door serving its rows to a member either: reaction rows come only through the data door and the record-page payload, both under the caller's grant. So both `404`s are the rule's answer, the member must not be served these definitions, and the fix is on the page: it stops asking.

**Where the page asked, and what changes.**

- `sys_business_unit`: the record and list routes ask, by name, the definitions of their object's lookup targets, for the cells that link and name them (`lookupTargetNames`, `appObjectScope.ts`). The platform adds `owning_business_unit_id` (and `organization_id`) to objects as `hidden: true` system lookups, so every route asked `sys_business_unit` (and `sys_organization`) for a field no cell draws. `lookupTargetNames` now skips a field declared `hidden: true`. This holds for every caller: the definitions were never drawn, so an administrator's page loses nothing but two requests.
- `sys_comment_reaction`: the record view asks whether the deployment has the object to choose where reactions are stored (`useObjectPresence`), and the absent answer takes the column store. A caller whose loaded grants hold no read on the object is now not asked and takes that same store directly: the server could only have answered absent. With no permission provider mounted (every grant reads open) the page asks as before; a caller who holds the read asks as before.

No server answer changes and nothing a caller sees on the page changes.

## Tests

- `appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx`, new top-level describe `objectstack#33343 — a hidden lookup asks no definition of its target`: the route asks `object/sys_user` (the drawn `owner` lookup) and never `sys_organization` / `sys_business_unit` behind hidden lookups; CONTROL: the same lookups un-hidden ask all three targets.
- `RecordDetailView.feedGrant-12082.test.tsx`, new top-level describe: a caller with no read on `sys_comment_reaction` asks the registry nothing about it and reads no reaction rows; CONTROL: a caller holding the read asks it and the records store reads its rows; CONTROL: no permission provider asks as before.

## Acceptance notes

- **Pre-existing, not changed here (reported, not filed):** on a framework that has `sys_comment_reaction`, a member with no grant on it lands on the column store (today through the `404`, now directly). That store offers the reaction control on `sys_comment` update, which `member_default` grants, and a click writes the retired `sys_comment.reactions` column. Whether a member should hold reactions at all (a `member_default` line beside the `sys_comment` one) or the column store should be dropped is a decision, listed in the report.
- A visible lookup to an object a member cannot read still asks its target by name and is answered `404`; that is outside this card's two objects.

## Verification

All readings at head `e7b95eff`, server code identical to `origin/main` `ba35dfd7` (the diff touches `ui/` and one changeset only).

<details><summary>Premise, live: a fresh showcase boot, an invited member bound to showcase_contributor and showcase_finance, and the seeded admin</summary>

- `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME`, member / admin: `sys_business_unit` 404 / 200, `sys_comment_reaction` 404 / 200, `sys_organization` 200 / 200, `sys_user` 200 / 200, `sys_comment` 200 / 200, `showcase_project` 200 / 200, `sys_approval_action` (an object the rule withholds) 404 / 200.
- Member `GET /api/v1/meta/object?names=sys_business_unit,sys_comment_reaction,sys_user` lists `sys_user` only.
- Member data door: `sys_business_unit` 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `sys_comment_reaction` 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `sys_comment` 200.
- The member's served `showcase_project` carries `organization_id` (sys_organization, hidden true) and `owning_business_unit_id` (sys_business_unit, hidden true) beside the drawn `owner_id` / `created_by` / `updated_by` / `account` lookups.
- The pre-existing column-store note above: the member's `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_comment/ID` with `reactions` answers 400 `INVALID_FIELD`; a `POST /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction` answers 403.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites and ablations</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.feedGrant-12082.test.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.reactionRecords-12078.test.tsx`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 43 passed (43).
- Ablation 1 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the `hidden === true` skip deleted): the hidden-lookup pin fails, `expected [ 'object?package=app.crm', …(3) ] to deeply equal [ 'object?package=app.crm', …(1) ]`, 1 failed / 7 passed; restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2 (`reactionReadRefused` forced `false`): the refused-caller pin fails, `expected [ 'sys_comment_reaction', …(5) ] to not include 'sys_comment_reaction'`, 1 failed / 24 passed; restored, blob equals HEAD.
- Local gates, each exit 0: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`.
- CI on this head: every run check-run green, including `Test UI` (all shards), `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Test Core`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`.
</details>
